_note: The preconditioned half. Section 8 carries two bullets -- *data-defined events with preconditions, choices and consequences* and *crisis events that force a response under time pressure* -- and the honest split between them is not two machines, it is whether the event carries a `preconditions` block. data/events/scandals.json is the pure-hazard half: a revelation arrives whether or not it is deserved. These three are earned.
_threshold_note: EVERY THRESHOLD BELOW WAS MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS AUTHORED, by tools/events_probe.gd table E0, and that ordering is V1.7c's correction applied to CONTENT rather than to a constant. Table R1 of the referendum probe cleared its own kill switch on approvals no French president can hold; R6 then measured the reachable range and the crossover sat outside it. A precondition written outside the reachable range of its field is a crisis that never happens, and nothing in the test suite would catch it -- the content loads, the machine works, and nothing fires. E0's occupancy over 168 months of FRA: deficit_pct_gdp >= 5.5 holds 74 % of hands_off and 0 % of managed; unemployment_pct >= 7.5 holds 40 % and 43 %; unrest_pct >= 10.0 holds 9 % and 0 %. Each row separates the regimes, which is what a precondition is for.
_sign_note: `deficit_pct_gdp` IS POSITIVE FOR A SHORTFALL. Budget.tick_month() sets it to total_spending_pct_gdp - total_revenue_pct_gdp, so austerity reads -9.41 because it runs a surplus, and balance_probe.gd's _print_row() negates it for display -- which is why every deficit quoted in CLAUDE.md and in the model docs carries the opposite sign from the field. The plan for this session had it the other way round and E0's first run corrected it, before a line of content existed. An event authored on the plan's sign would have fired only on a SURPLUS.
_decree_note: THE FISCAL EVENT BELOW IS THE ORPHANED V1 MECHANIC. `Decree / executive order -- bypass the assembly on a narrow set of matters, at a legitimacy cost` is tiered V1 in docs/brainstorm/mechanics-governance.md and appears in no row of any tier doc; forty-three prior stale-row instances never caught it. A choice that moves a budget line with no assembly division IS that mechanic: the narrow set of matters is what this file names, and the legitimacy cost is the choice's own bloc_offset. What an event choice may NOT do is write effects.institutional, because that is `Emergency powers -- suspend normal process during crisis. Addictive and corrosive`, tiered Someday in the same table. src/core/event.gd refuses it by name.

events.name: The books are called in
events.summary: The deficit has passed the point where the Commission writes letters and the markets stop reading them. You are expected to say what you will do about it, in public, this quarter.

choices.label: Cut by decree
choices.summary: Three lines down, no vote taken. The books improve and the people who use those services notice which government did it.

choices.label: Raise the rate instead
choices.summary: Consumption carries it. Quieter than a spending cut and it lands on everybody.

choices.label: Say the books are fine
choices.summary: They are not, and the people who lend to you can read.

events.name: The unions set a date
events.summary: The federations have agreed a date and a list. They would rather have a settlement than the date, and they have said so in a way that leaves you a fortnight.

choices.label: Settle in full
choices.summary: Industrial peace, bought at the pension line and paid for every month after.

choices.label: Concede the smaller half
choices.summary: Cheaper, and it buys proportionately less.

choices.label: Hold the line
choices.summary: You keep the money and they keep the date.

events.name: Industry asks for terms
events.summary: With unemployment where it is, the industrial federation has come with two proposals and a warning about which plants close if it gets neither.

choices.label: Lift the sector's burden
choices.summary: The rules come off industry. What was protecting somebody stops protecting them.

choices.label: Underwrite the plants
choices.summary: Conditions attached and money behind them. Industry keeps the payroll and loses the freedom.
